question: Which AQI range corresponds to "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**101-150**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Air Quality Index (AQI) categorizes air quality into six levels, each representing a range of values and associated health concerns.
 
• The "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups" category corresponds to AQI values between **101-150**, as per standards set by organizations like the United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).
 
• This range is particularly concerning for sensitive groups, including children, older adults, and individuals with pre-existing respiratory or heart conditions.
 
• During this AQI level, these sensitive groups may experience health effects, while the general public is less likely to be affected.
 
• Sources of pollutants in this range often include emissions from vehicles, industrial activities, and natural sources like wildfires.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Air Quality Index (AQI):** A numerical scale used to communicate how polluted the air currently is or how polluted it is forecasted to become.
 
• **Key Pollutants:** The AQI is calculated based on pollutants like PM2.5, PM10, ozone, carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, and nitrogen dioxide.
 
• **Sensitive Groups:** These include individuals with pre-existing health conditions, children, and elderly people who are more vulnerable to the effects of air pollution.
 
• **Health Effects of 101-150 AQI:** Sensitive groups may experience respiratory or cardiovascular symptoms, such as difficulty breathing or chest pain.
 
• **Preventive Measures:** Avoid outdoor activities for extended periods, use air purifiers indoors, and wear protective masks when necessary during this AQI range.
